question: Out of the following which is not a non conventional source of energy:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nuclear energy**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nuclear energy is not a non-conventional source of energy**, but rather a conventional energy source. 
 
• **Non-conventional energy **
 
 
• It is renewable energy which is used by human beings for a long time.
 
• This type of energy is continuously produced in nature and is inexhaustible.
 
• Non-conventional sources of energy include solar energy, wind, and biomass.
 
• These sources do not produce any pollution in the environment.
 
• Examples are Wood, Solar energy, wind energy, hydropower, tidal energy, geothermal energy, Biomass Energy, etc.
 
• **Geothermal Energy** - It Utilizes heat from beneath the Earth's surface.
 
• **Solar Energy** - It Harnesses energy from the Sun.
 
• **Tidal Energy- It **Uses the kinetic energy of tides.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** A conventional source of energy is a natural resource that is available in nature and is available in limited quantities.

 
• They are also known as a non-renewable source of energy as once depleted, they cannot be re-generated easily.
 
• They are formed from decay matter over hundreds and millions of years. 
 
• Examples are Oil, Coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear fuels, hydel power, etc.
